fuse_gtest_files: run fuse_gtest_files.py to fuse Google Test source code into a single .h and .cc file
fuse_gtest_h: run FuseGTestH to scan gtest root directory and generate a fused gtest.h header file
fuse_gtest_all_cc: run FuseGTestAllCc to scan gtest root directory and generate a fused gtest-all.cc source file
validate_gtest_root_dir: run ValidateGTestRootDir to verify the given directory is a valid Google Test root directory
validate_output_dir: run ValidateOutputDir to verify the output directory is valid and files can be written
